=== usage
exit 2
--- stdout
--- stderr
Usage: create-idea-sandbox.py <name> <purpose>
Output: the last line is one JSON object (lease-runner's POST /v1/sandboxes turns it straight into the response):
  {"result": "created"|"exists_same", "name"}                              exit 0
  {"result": "bad_name"|"exists"|"too_many"|"create_failed", "detail", ...}  exit 1
  too_many also carries limit, current.
- Resend: same name and same purpose already registered → exists_same (the assistant resending after a timeout does
  not open a second one).
- Clash: same name but a different purpose, the name of a project, or the folder/bare repo/memory copy already exists
  → exists.
- Limit: hub.json's ideas.limit (default 20) projects of type: idea.
- onboard fails: removes the folder, bare repo, memory copy and the uncommitted registry file made this time (all
  checked beforehand not to exist), then returns create_failed.
Only one runs at a time (lock in <state>/idea-sandbox.lock) because onboarding commits to brunna.


=== bad name
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "bad_name", "detail": "The name may only use lowercase letters, digits and - (not at the start or end, at most 40 characters); got 'Bad_Name'"}
--- stderr

{"result": "exists", "detail": "agent-hub is the platform's own name"}
--- stderr

exit 1

{"result": "bad_name", "detail": "purpose cannot be empty"}
--- stderr

=== purpose too long
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "bad_name", "detail": "purpose is too long (501 characters, the limit is 500)"}
--- stderr

=== same idea again
exit 0
--- stdout
{"result": "exists_same", "name": "idea-1"}
--- stderr

=== another idea
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "exists", "detail": "idea-1 is already the name of another idea"}
--- stderr

=== a project
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "exists", "detail": "proj is already the name of a project"}
--- stderr

=== folders exist
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "exists", "detail": "notes is not registered, but these already exist: <TMP>/a/workspace/notes, <TMP>/a/go/notes-memory.git"}
--- stderr

=== onboard fails
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "create_failed", "detail": "onboard failed: step 1 ok / step 2 ok / boom: could not create the bare repo"}
--- stderr

=== onboard fails after commit
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "create_failed", "detail": "onboard failed: step 1 ok / step 2 ok / boom: could not create the bare repo (the registry file was already committed, so it was not deleted: handle it by hand)"}
--- stderr

=== created
exit 0
--- stdout
{"result": "created", "name": "room-3d"}
--- stderr

=== README
# room-3d

A project for exploring an idea (an idea sandbox), opened by the assistant for this idea:

> a 3D model of the room

Conclusions, decisions and to-dos from discuss leases go in memory (`.agent-memory/`); to turn it into a real project, use brunna's `bin/upgrade-idea.py`.

=== too many
exit 1
--- stdout
{"result": "too_many", "detail": "There is already 1 idea sandbox (limit 1)", "limit": 1, "current": 1}
--- stderr
